targets.rawQueryText: SELECT model, COUNT(*) as runs, AVG(cost_usd) as avg_cost_usd, AVG(latency_ms) as avg_latency_ms FROM generations WHERE mode = '$mode' GROUP BY model
targets.queryText: SELECT model, COUNT(*) as runs, AVG(cost_usd) as avg_cost_usd, AVG(latency_ms) as avg_latency_ms FROM generations WHERE mode = '$mode' GROUP BY model

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT g.model, AVG(e.structural_accuracy) as avg_structural_accuracy, COUNT(*) as scored_runs FROM generations g JOIN eval_results e ON e.generation_id = g.id WHERE g.mode = '$mode' AND e.structural_accuracy IS NOT NULL GROUP BY g.model
targets.queryText: SELECT g.model, AVG(e.structural_accuracy) as avg_structural_accuracy, COUNT(*) as scored_runs FROM generations g JOIN eval_results e ON e.generation_id = g.id WHERE g.mode = '$mode' AND e.structural_accuracy IS NOT NULL GROUP BY g.model
